definitions.gloss: elderly person, old person, senior citizen
definitions.explanation: A person of advanced age; typically refers to those in their later years of life.

examples.japanese: {老人|ろうじん}に{席|せき}を{譲|ゆず}った。
examples.english: I gave up my seat to an elderly person.

examples.japanese: {老人|ろうじん}ホームで{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work at a nursing home.
examples.notes: 老人ホーム = nursing home, retirement home

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}は{老人|ろうじん}{人口|じんこう}が{増|ふ}えている。

notes:
USAGE: {老人|ろうじん} is a neutral term for elderly people. In more polite or formal contexts, {高齢者|こうれいしゃ} (senior citizen) or お{年寄|としよ}り (elderly person, polite) may be preferred.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{老人|ろうじん}ホーム (nursing home)
・{老人|ろうじん}{福祉|ふくし} (elderly welfare)
・{老人|ろうじん}{介護|かいご} (elderly care)

CONTRAST:
・{老人|ろうじん} - neutral, somewhat clinical
・お{年寄|としよ}り - polite, softer
・{高齢者|こうれいしゃ} - formal, administrative term
